channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 17 Sep: Harare clear sky · high 27° / low 15°
item.description: Harare: high 27°, low 15° (clear sky) · Bulawayo: high 31°, low 18° (clear sky) · Mutare: high 27°, low 15° (clear sky) · Gweru: high 30°, low 16° (clear sky) · Masvingo: high 31°, low 18° (clear sky) · Victoria Falls: high 35°, low 19° (clear sky) Tsumo yezuva: Ateya mariva murutsva haatyi kusviba magaro.
